items.prompt: For indexed values [1,1,2] and target 2, what does deduplicating to [1,2] incorrectly remove?

options.text: The singleton at the original value 2.
options.why: That value remains present after this deduplication.

options.text: All valid subsets, so the correct answer becomes 0.

options.why: The empty subset totals 0 and does not explain the target 2 difference.

options.text: The subset containing both separate value 1 positions.
options.why: Original answer 2 counts the two ones together and the singleton 2; deduplication leaves only the latter.

items.explanation: Original answer 2 counts the two ones together and the singleton 2; deduplication leaves only the latter.
